_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج مراجعة المرحلة (Retrospective) هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع.

Start.guidance: Actions and behaviors that the team will begin to implement

Stop.guidance: Actions or behaviors that the team will cease doing

Keep.guidance: Practices that the team should continue with

More.guidance: Practices that were not done consistently that should be done more often

Less.guidance: Practices that were done too much or that should be reduced
